title: Repeating events ask this event, this and following, or all events
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2), click an Interview (a repeating event you organize) and change its title
Press Save and read the question
Choose This and following events (then repeat with All events on another Interview)
Open a one-off event of yours and change its title
expected: A repeating event asks This event, This and following events or All events before anything is saved; a one-off event does not ask. Changing how the series repeats offers only the last two.
